name: @red-cup-engineering/workspace-filesystem-provider
description: Root-confined POSIX reads and atomic writes with content-addressed custody receipts.

read-workspace-file.accepts: a custody root and relative file path

write-workspace-file.accepts: a custody root, relative file path, expected SHA-256, and UTF-8 content
write-workspace-file.returns: an atomic write receipt appended to the settlement outbox
